title: XcQwfqq Hub v21 Keyless
features:
AC Supported: 2025-12-13

If you run into issues, include:
- Executor Used
- Options Enabled
- Device Type (PC / Mobile)

How data is sent and stored:
- Local encoding: Before leaving your device, all collected data (UserId, Username, Executor, etc.) is converted to JSON.
- Obfuscation: The JSON is hashed/obfuscated with SHA-512. Raw data is not readable.
- Transmission: The obfuscated string is sent securely via HTTPS to the database.
- Storage: Only the obfuscated data is stored. No unencrypted personal data is exposed during transit or storage.

Summary for users:
- Data is never sent in plain text.
- You can opt out of data collection in the Main Tab.

Delta Notice:
- Delta may flag this script as a scam. This is a false positive.
- Disable Anti-Scam in Delta settings before running.
